pro_photo_v2.grading: Cinematic documentary grade. Neutral 5200-5600K color temp. Anti-orange. Shadows warm, highlights clean. Lifted blacks. Organic grain. Tack-sharp, crisp focus, zero motion blur.
pro_photo_v2.lighting: Natural gym lighting with warm shadows. No studio flash look. Documentary not commercial.
pro_photo_v2.contrast: Medium-high. Deep blacks but not crushed. Film-like roll-off in highlights.

dramatic_cinema.grading: High contrast cinematic. Deep blacks, pulled highlights. Dramatic. Arri Alexa look.
dramatic_cinema.lighting: Side lighting dominant. Strong shadows. Rim light optional.

noir.grading: Black and white or desaturated. High contrast. Gritty.
noir.lighting: Hard light, deep shadows. One dominant source.

manga.grading: Clean lines, flat color areas. Anime cel-shading feel.

note: When locked=true, every image generation auto-appends the currentStyle parameters. Toggle via /stylelock on Telegram.
